jobs.description:

Description

We are Disturbia; a UK based fashion and lifestyle brand for the people who play on the outskirts of mainstream; we celebrate the unusual, the quirky and the people who are gloriously themselves.
Our passions span folklore to psychodelia; magical fairytales to poison gardens, historic literature to witchcraft and all the other weird rabbit holes we can fall down.

Over the last 20 years, our growing in-house team of creatives, do-ers, dreamers and makers have been creating distinctive products and delivering an exceptional experience for those of you who dare to stand out from the crowd.

The spirit of our collections comes from the spirit inside our company. We’re a team of honest, humble, creatively minded souls across our offices in the North East and London. We all dream of the same goal; to grow a brand which enables millions of people to realise their unique selves
.

Our designs are informed and inspired by the outcast, the esoteric, and the occult- we're always spinning fashion trends on their head in new and unexpected ways. We stand for the other in society and always want to do right by our community - all while having a hell of a lot of fun in the process.

We are a fast growing and dynamic environment; and we don’t believe it bureaucracy for bureaucracy sake – you won’t find pointless red tape around here. We value bright ideas and voices which want to be heard. If you want to do your best work and come and work in environment which reflects you true self, come and join us and make some magic.

As Disturbia continues to grow, the need has arisen to hire a Creative Producer, with at least 3 years’ experience, to join our Brand Team in London.

Our aesthetic is rooted in the whimsical, witchy, and esoteric
— think celestial motifs, folk magic, alchemical symbols, dreamy botanicals, and vintage occult references. We're looking for someone who can partner with the Creative Lead and Head of Brand Development to elevate our content across the whole of Disturbia.

You’ll play a key role in running end-to-end production on all our creative shoots, whilst being the go-to person for pre-production, securing teams, on set production and working all the way through to delivery of assets.

Key Responsibilities

The successful candidate should aim to meet the following capability requirements:
Work collaboratively with the Lead Creative and Head of Brand to deliver on brand, best in class photography and videography content that aligns with the brand's vision.
Leading production on creative shoots within allocated budget, developing shoot decks, shot lists and schedules. Production lead across pre-production, on set and post production.
Running production on set.
Working across production on shoots locally, remotely and on destination.
Retouch and edit notes for creatives. QC-ing all assets across motion and stills.
Managing and developing budgets including negotiating competitive prices with an understanding of industry rates. Reconciling budgets and processing invoices.
Managing timelines and ensuring deadlines are met.
Art buying, sourcing crew and suggesting best talent suitable for briefs. Sourcing new talent & curating a black book of teams for the brand to work with that executes the brands vision.
Efficient management and delivery of all allocated projects against a critical path and budgeted cost per style.
Effectively communicate the creative vision and requirements to team members, ensuring everyone is aligned on the project's goals.
Working with buying and design for sample management across campaigns. Collaborating on sample availability and working alongside the Sample Co-Ordinator to make sure required samples are available on time to meet deadlines for creative shoots.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues that arise during the shoot, ensuring a smooth and efficient production process.
Collaborating on creation and maintenance of organisation tools and documents created for shoot management.
Support the creative lead and Head of Brand as needed on campaign concepting, styling and creative elements.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Minimum 3 years’ experience working end-to-end on shoot production or in a similar role
Experience with stills & video production is necessary
Excellent organisation, administration and presentation skills are a must.
Experience in fashion preferred.
Systems and data management: confident with excel, project management systems & reporting
Presentation skills: strong presentation skills required, experience with canva and miro beneficial
Problem solving: You are proactive, solutions-focused and comfortable making practical recommendations that support smooth production
Budget Management: comfortable working to a budget, negotiating rates with freelancers, logging invoices & tracking costs.

Personal Qualities
Creative and curious
— you love exploring new visual languages and weaving stories into your work
Strong communicator
— able to share ideas clearly and take on feedback with openness and positivity
Highly organised
— able to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines without losing attention to detail
Team-oriented
— you enjoy collaborating, contributing ideas, and supporting others in a close-knit team
Self-motivated and adaptable
— comfortable working independently, showing initiative, and adapting to a growing brand’s needs
Passionate and aligned
— you resonate with our brand’s vision and aesthetic, and bring that energy to everything you do

Benefits

Holiday allowance starting at 23 days, on top of bank holidays, increasing with length of service.
Annual purchase scheme
Hybrid and flexible working.
Enhanced parental leave
Store discount- 30% after probationary period and 50% after a years service
Sample sale in both offices
Friends & Family Discount
Regular socials and social fund
Cycle to work scheme
Birthday treats
We believe that creative freedom needs space to breathe; this is why we offer flexible working hours, 2 days a week working from home and a respect for the life you have outside of our walls.
We would be nothing without our community of creative folk; we celebrate our whole together twice a year within a company wide social

Inclusivity is a guiding principle in the culture at Disturbia, whether for our employees, customers or suppliers.

We have created an environment where our people feels valued, respected and celebrated for their unique qualities and perspectives.We are committed to prioritising our awareness, constantly learning and growing as we strive to create a more inclusive and empowered future for all we cross paths with.

Our commitment to belonging is woven into the fabric of our company values, driving us to always support diversity and inclusivity as we celebrate the magic in everyone.

, you will lead and develop our growing creative team in Dubai. Set to grow to around five content producers and digital and print designers, the team needs a strong creative leader who provides clear direction, develops ideas and concepts, and ensures consistently high-quality execution.

The focus of this role is on creative leadership and conceptual strength, combined with the ability to turn ideas into high-quality work with structure and pace.

Based at our office in Dubai, UAE
, you will report directly to our Global Creative Lead at our international headquarters in Hamburg, Germany
. Together, you will translate seca's global brand and marketing strategy into compelling campaigns, content, and design, with our Design Guide providing the creative framework.

What you will work on

Lead & Develop:
Lead, motivate, and develop our growing creative team, helping people strengthen their skills, take ownership, and deliver their best work.
Guide Creative Quality:
Give clear creative guidance, sharpen ideas, review concepts and designs, and provide constructive feedback that raises the quality of the team's work.
Create & Direct:
Develop campaign concepts yourself, from the core idea and look and feel to visual storytelling and art direction across channels.
Connect Strategy & Creativity:
Translate global brand and marketing strategy from Hamburg into clear, inspiring, and actionable creative briefs.
Strengthen Our Visual Identity:
Ensure consistently high-quality design and brand consistency across digital and print, working within seca's established visual identity and Design Guide.
Drive Creative Delivery:
Set priorities and move creative projects forward with the right balance of quality, pace, and reliable deadlines.

What you bring

Creative Experience:
At least 8 years of relevant experience in a creative agency, design studio, or internationally oriented in-house environment.
Leadership Experience:
Several years of experience leading and developing creative teams, with the ability to motivate people and provide clear creative guidance.
Concept & Art Direction:
Strong experience developing campaign concepts and translating ideas into compelling visual communication across different channels.
A Strong Portfolio:
A portfolio that demonstrates your own conceptual strength as well as your ability to guide and elevate the work of others.
Creative Judgement:
A strong eye for design, visual quality, and brand consistency, paired with the confidence to challenge ideas and make clear creative decisions.
International Perspective:
Experience creating work for international brands and audiences and collaborating across markets and cultures.
Clear Communication:
Very good English and the ability to communicate ideas and feedback clearly in an international environment. German is a plus, but not required.

What we offer

At seca, you will combine the opportunities of a growing international setup with the stability and long-term perspective of a family-owned Health Tech company.
International Collaboration:
Work closely with our Global Creative Lead in Hamburg and colleagues across seca's international organization.
Room to Lead & Create:
Combine creative leadership with the opportunity to develop concepts and take on art direction yourself.
A Growing Team:
Develop people and help shape our growing creative setup in Dubai.
Long-Term Perspective:
Join a fourth-generation family-owned company with more than 185 years of history and an international growth perspective.
Time to Recharge:
Benefit from a 40-hour working week and 30 calendar days of annual leave.
Support in Dubai:
Health insurance and visa costs covered by seca, plus an annual flight home after 12 months of service.

About seca

Founded in Hamburg in 1840, seca has grown from a precision scale workshop into a global Health Tech company. For more than 185 years, we have developed devices and software solutions that help healthcare professionals make better decisions in hospitals, clinics, rehabilitation centers, and fitness facilities around the world.

Today, seca is a fourth-generation family-owned company with 17 international branches, combining long-term thinking with international growth and the ambition to shape the future of Health Tech.

Ready to lead great creative work in Dubai?

jobs.title: Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben.
Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.
Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm
). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet
.
Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.
Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.
Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Du willst in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Europas mit überzeugenden Creatives dazu beitragen, die Brücke zwischen klinischer Forschung und überzeugenden Botschaften für Patientinnen zu schlagen? Dich treibt die Frage um, warum bestimmte Gesundheitsbotschaften wirken, und du bist bereit, Ownership für die Insights und Prozesse zu übernehmen, die unsere gesamte Creative-Pipeline optimieren? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen ab sofort einen Creative Strategist (w/m/d) für Kijimea. Du wirst Teil eines Teams, das Klarheit, Wissenschaft und Kundenverhalten konsequent in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Gemeinsam erschließen wir neue Wachstumschancen, indem wir kreative Konzepte systematisch testen und unsere Position als vertrauenswürdigste, datengetriebene Marke in der Kategorie Verdauungsgesundheit weiter ausbauen.
Deine Aufgaben

Du führst quantitative sowie qualitative Markt- und Zielgruppenanalysen durch, um Präferenzen, Motive und Bedürfnisse der Zielgruppen fundiert zu verstehen.
Du schreibst Direct-Response-Skripte für den Bereich Video-Content und nutzt dabei Storytelling-Elemente, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erzeugen und überzeugend zu argumentieren.
Du erstellst klare, datenbasierte Briefings für unsere Agenturpartner, damit überzeugender Content entsteht
Du tauchst tief in Performance-Daten ein und identifizierst, warum ein Creative gewonnen oder verloren hat – ob Hook, medizinischer Claim oder visuelles Format – und spielst die Learnings direkt in die Produktion zu-rück.
Du bringst proaktiv Ideen ein, die unsere Online-Kampagnenziele unterstützen und sich stringent in die Gesamtstrategie einfügen.

Dein Profil

Du hast ein Studium oder eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung z.B. im Bereich Kommunikationswissenschaften, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Journalismus oder Marketing.
Du konntest bereits mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrungen im Bereich Creative Strategy sammeln (idealerweise in einer Agentur oder in einem Start-/Scale-up) und möchtest deine Skills nun bei einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare Player weltweit einbringen und weiter ausbauen.
Du verstehst, dass Content auf Plattformen wie Meta oder Youtube ein entscheidender Performance Treiber ist und brennst dafür, neue Formate und Angles zu entwickeln und zu testen
Du arbeitest datenbasiert und gehst analytisch ins Detail; seien es kommerzielle KPI wie ROAS oder CPO, oder auch Klick-, Hook- oder Engagement Rates
Du arbeitest äußerst strukturiert, sorgfältig und zuverlässig.
Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Level) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2-Level).

Unser Versprechen

Wir bieten Dir einen vielfältigen, anspruchsvollen Job mit spannenden Aufgaben und einem breiten Spektrum an Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten! Unser innovatives Umfeld ermöglicht Dir Deine berufliche Entfaltung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, Verantwortung von Tag 1 an und den Freiraum, neue Wege zu gehen. Auf Dich wartet individuelles Learning und echte Sinnhaftigkeit – schenke mit Deinem persönlichen Beitrag Millionen von Menschen ein neues Leben!

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Specialist (Paid Media)
jobs.description:
MEFITPRO & QOOAH | Dubai, UAE | Full-Time

About Us

MEFITPRO is an established leader in the Middle East's fitness industry, providing commercial fitness equipment, professional fitness education, sports nutrition solutions, and industry events.

QOOAH is our consumer-facing fitness and wellness retail brand, offering a curated range of fitness equipment, sports nutrition, recovery products, and wellness essentials through e-commerce and retail channels.

As we strengthen our digital growth capabilities, we're looking for a commercially driven Performance Marketing Specialist
to own and optimise paid acquisition across both businesses.

The Role

You'll be responsible for planning, executing, and optimising paid advertising campaigns that generate qualified leads for MEFITPRO and profitable online sales for QOOAH.

This is a hands-on, performance-driven role requiring strong analytical skills, technical platform expertise, and a clear understanding of how advertising investment translates into business results.

You'll work closely with marketing leadership, the social media team, e-commerce, and commercial departments to build scalable acquisition systems across both brands.

We're looking for someone who understands that successful advertising isn't measured by clicks or impressions, but by the commercial outcomes it produces.

Key Responsibilities

1. Paid Media Strategy & Campaign Management

Plan, launch, manage, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other relevant platforms.
Develop distinct acquisition strategies for MEFITPRO's B2B business and QOOAH's B2C e-commerce operations.
Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting, bidding strategies, creative testing, and performance optimisation.
Build full-funnel acquisition campaigns covering awareness, consideration, conversion, and remarketing.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve acquisition efficiency and scale successful campaigns.
Maintain structured campaign naming conventions, reporting dashboards, and testing documentation.

2. MEFITPRO: B2B Lead Generation

Develop lead generation campaigns targeting gym owners, fitness operators, hospitality groups, developers, and commercial fitness facilities.
Generate qualified enquiries for commercial fitness equipment, facility solutions, and relevant business services.
Build targeted campaigns for professional fitness certifications, educational programmes, and workshops.
Develop campaign structures based on customer segments, business lines, geography, and commercial objectives.
Collaborate with sales teams to track lead quality, qualification rates, pipeline progression, and conversion into customers.
Optimise campaigns based on cost per qualified lead and commercial outcomes, not lead volume alone.
Support targeted campaigns for industry events, product launches, and strategic partnerships.

3. QOOAH: E-commerce Growth & Customer Acquisition

Manage performance campaigns designed to generate online sales across fitness equipment, sports nutrition, recovery, and wellness categories.
Develop and optimize Google, and Meta sales campaigns.
Manage product catalogue advertising, dynamic product ads, and remarketing audiences.
Analyse performance by product category, campaign, audience, and customer segment.
Collaborate with the e-commerce team to align advertising with product availability, pricing, promotions, and margins.
Improve return on advertising spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), and contribution profitability.
Identify high-potential products and categories that can be scaled profitably.
Support seasonal campaigns, new product launches, and promotional initiatives.

4. Tracking, Attribution & Analytics

Implement, monitor, and troubleshoot conversion tracking across advertising platforms.
Work with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and relevant e-commerce tracking tools.
Ensure accurate measurement of leads, purchases, revenue, and other key conversion events.
Collaborate with the web and e-commerce teams to resolve tracking, landing page, and conversion issues.
Build clear performance dashboards showing advertising investment, acquisition costs, conversion rates, and revenue contribution.
Analyse campaign performance using platform data, analytics, CRM data, and actual sales outcomes.
Identify tracking discrepancies and communicate their impact on reporting and decision-making.

5. Creative Testing & Conversion Optimisation

Work closely with Social Media & Content to develop high-performing advertising creatives.
Prepare clear creative briefs based on audience insights, customer objections, campaign performance, and product opportunities.
Run structured A/B tests across messaging, creative formats, audiences, offers, and landing pages.
Identify opportunities to improve landing page conversion rates and reduce acquisition costs.
Analyse competitor advertising, market trends, and emerging platform opportunities.
Maintain a continuous testing and learning process to improve performance.

6. Budget Management & Performance Reporting

Monitor daily campaign spending and ensure budgets are allocated efficiently.
Prepare weekly performance updates and monthly reports with clear commercial insights.
Track performance against agreed KPIs, targets, and acquisition budgets.
Recommend budget reallocations based on performance, profitability, and growth opportunities.
Present actionable recommendations to marketing leadership and relevant commercial teams.
Flag underperforming campaigns early and take corrective action.

Required

What We're Looking For

3–4 years of hands-on experience managing performance marketing campaigns.
Proven experience with both Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
Demonstrable success generating qualified leads and/or scaling e-commerce sales.
Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, and attribution.
Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets with clear performance accountability.
Strong analytical capabilities and confidence working with spreadsheets, dashboards, and performance data.
Ability to independently build, launch, optimize, and troubleshoot campaigns.
Understanding of customer acquisition economics, conversion rates, CAC, ROAS, and marketing ROI.
Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and ownership of results.
Strong English communication skills.
Based in Dubai or willing to relocate.

Highly Desirable

Experience managing both B2B lead generation and B2C e-commerce advertising.
Previous experience in fitness, wellness, sports nutrition, consumer retail, or related industries.
Experience with Shopify, WooCommerce, or similar e-commerce platforms.
Experience with CRM-integrated lead generation and offline conversion tracking.
Familiarity with Google Merchant Center, product feeds, and catalogue management.
Experience advertising across UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider GCC markets.
Understanding of contribution margins, customer lifetime value, and e-commerce unit economics.
Arabic language skills are an advantage.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, we expect you to:

Complete a full audit of existing paid advertising accounts, conversion tracking, and campaign performance across both businesses.
Establish reliable reporting and measurement frameworks for MEFITPRO and QOOAH.
Implement structured acquisition campaigns aligned with each brand's commercial priorities.
Improve the quality and efficiency of MEFITPRO's lead generation.
Identify and scale QOOAH's strongest-performing product categories and campaigns.
Establish a consistent creative testing and optimisation process.
Demonstrate clear ownership of budgets, performance, and commercial results.
Present a data-backed growth roadmap for the following quarter.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to manage performance marketing across two complementary businesses operating in the Middle East's growing fitness and wellness industry.

From B2B commercial fitness solutions and professional education to consumer e-commerce and premium wellness products, you'll work across multiple acquisition models, customer segments, and growth opportunities.

You'll have direct exposure to marketing leadership, meaningful commercial objectives, and the opportunity to build scalable acquisition systems that contribute directly to business growth.

Secondary: Workflows that outlast the handoff: A solution has limited value if its users depend on its creator to keep it running. The supporting challenge is making workflows understandable, maintainable and usable by the teams they serve, without constant technical support.

The Career Accelerator

Weil wir in der Content-Branche arbeiten und uns ein kurzes Video in zwei Minuten mehr über dich sagt als jedes Anschreiben.

Loom ist ein kostenloses Tool, mit dem du dich selbst und/oder deinen Bildschirm aufnimmst und per Link teilst. Die kostenlose Version reicht völlig. Du kannst auch jedes andere Tool nutzen (z. B. Handyvideo über Google Drive) Hauptsache, wir können den Link öffnen.

Bitte auf Deutsch, da unsere Kunden überwiegend aus dem DACH-Raum kommen.

Nur die Personen, die bei uns am Bewerbungsprozess beteiligt sind. Wir teilen es nicht weiter und löschen es nach Abschluss des Verfahrens.
